senses.gloss:
ऋषि ऋष् + इ (for original ऋषन्, cf. अक्षि for अक्षन्, अस्थि for अस्थन्, etc., = ἄρσην, ἄῤῥην), m.
 1. A bard or author of sacred hymns, Chr. 287, 1. 3; Man. 11, 243.
 2. An old saint, MBh. 12, 12724; [] Hariv. 417, seq.
 3. A pious person, especially an anchorite, Man. 4, 94.
 --Comp.
ऋषित्व ऋषि-त्व, n. State of a ऋषि, MBh. 13, 2896.
ऋषि- + कुल्या ऋषि- + कुल्या, f. 1. a holy river, MBh. 2, 1041. 2. the name of a river, MBh. 3, 8026. 3. a proper name, Bhāg. P. 5, 15, 5.
ऋषि- + यज्ञ ऋषि- + यज्ञ, m. inaudible muttering of prayers, Man. 4, 21; cf. 3, 81.
